# Layers -- Agent API

> Layers is a browser-based image/video editor. An agent can join the person's
> own open Layers over Seance, the Noise Factor collaboration service, and run
> Layers' commands in it: add and change layers, paint, select, mask, and look
> at the canvas. An agent that drives its own browser can call the same
> commands through the in-page `window.LayersAgent` API instead. This file is
> the contract for software agents that control Layers.

The full contract adds a reference for every command and its arguments:
https://layers.noisefactor.io/llms-full.txt

Layers is an island. Its document is a stack of layers, not program text, and
it shares nothing with other apps. A Layers session joins only Layers, and
programs and images do not move between Layers and Noisedeck, Polymorphic,
Visualize, HD4, Foundry or Shade.

For the roles and control paths of the other Noise Factor products,
including Timeline's project-folder CLI and Layers' separate document, start
from the platform guide at https://noisefactor.io/llms.txt.

## Connect to the person's Layers

Use this route when you can run shell commands. It works with the Layers the
person already has open: their composition and their canvas.

1. Ask the person to open https://layers.noisefactor.io, choose
   **connect agent...** in the File menu, click **Go Online**, then
   **Copy Prompt**, and paste the prompt to you. The prompt names this file and
   the session link. (Without that dialog: File, **live collab...**,
   **Take Online**, then send the link or the six-character code.)
2. Get the agent tool. It needs Node 22.4 or later and nothing else:
   `curl -fsSLO https://noisedeck.app/agent/seance-agent.mjs`
3. Join: `node seance-agent.mjs join <link-or-code>`. It prints the session
   name (`layers`), its `dialect` (`layers`), its `rev` and the open app tabs.
   A background process keeps the session joined between commands.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `node seance-agent.mjs commands` | Lists Layers' commands and their arguments. `[not available remotely]` marks the commands that a session cannot run. |
| `node seance-agent.mjs call <command> [JSON]` | Runs one command in the person's tab and prints its envelope, for example `call addLayer '{"kind":"effect","effectId":"synth/gradient"}'`. |
| `node seance-agent.mjs look [--size N] [--format png\|jpg] [--out FILE]` | Saves an image of the person's canvas (`getThumbnail`). Its path is `result.envelope.result.image.path`; open the file with your image tool. |
| `node seance-agent.mjs status` | Lists the joined sessions. For a Layers session, `rev` counts the changes to its document. |
| `node seance-agent.mjs wait [--since REV] [--timeout S]` | Waits until the person changes the composition. With `--since`, a change after that `rev` from `status` returns at once. |
| `node seance-agent.mjs image-put <file>` | Adds a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP file to the session. `result.ref` is its `image:<id>`. |
| `node seance-agent.mjs image-get <id> [--out FILE]` | Saves an image that the session holds to a file. |
| `node seance-agent.mjs leave` / `stop` | Leaves the session / stops the background process. |

Every command prints JSON, except `commands`, which prints text (`--json`
gives JSON). The exit code is 0 for success, 1 when Layers
refused the command (read `result.envelope.error.code`), and 2 when the tool
could not run it (read `error.code`; the codes are listed below). The tool
leaves `state` out of the envelopes that it prints; `--state` keeps it.
`node seance-agent.mjs help` lists every option.

`program`, `set` and `validate` do not apply to Layers, which has no program
text: `program` answers `NO_DOCUMENT`, and `set` and `validate` answer
`NOT_FOUND_COMMAND`. `transfer` to or from a Layers session answers `ISLAND`.

To follow the person: read `rev` from `status`, do your work, then run
`wait --since <rev>`. It returns when the person changes the composition.
Your own commands do not count as the person's changes. A change that the
person makes while one of your commands runs counts as yours, so `wait` does
not report it: read the composition again before each edit.

How it works, so you can explain it to the person:

- The tool joins the session as an anonymous participant, which the person
  sees join. It runs commands in the tab that took the composition online,
  through the session, with the same checks as the in-page API. The changes
  appear in the person's layer stack, and the person can undo them. A tab
  that joined the session from its link does not answer, even one that
  becomes the session's owner after the person's tab leaves. After the person
  reloads their tab, it answers again (a copy of it that the browser
  duplicates answers too).
- Everyone in the session receives every answer, and anyone who can edit the
  session can send commands to that tab. So nothing that the person keeps in
  this browser is reachable through a session: saved projects
  (`getProjectInfo`, `listProjects`, `openProject`, `saveProject`,
  `saveProjectAs`, `deleteProject`), settings and the foreground color
  (`getSettings`, `setSettings`, `getForegroundColor`, `setForegroundColor`),
  fonts (`listInstalledFonts`, `installFontBundle`), exports and their
  jobs (`exportImage`, `exportVideo`, `releaseExport`, `getJob`,
  `waitForJob`, `cancelJob`), recovery copies (`listRecoveryCopies`,
  `restoreRecoveryCopy`, `discardRecoveryCopy`), the session itself
  (`takeOnline`, `joinSession`, `goOffline`) and exact pixels
  (`getRasterRegion`). `newProject` would also take the session
  offline. These commands answer `REMOTE_UNAVAILABLE`, and `commands` marks
  them. Suggest that the person goes offline (File, **stop live collab**, then
  **Go Offline**) when you are done.
- In each answer, `state` leaves out `foreground`, `jobs`, `recentExports`
  and `settings`. `state.project` keeps only `canUndo` and `canRedo`, and the
  `media` of a media layer has no `filename`.
- `undo` and `redo` stay within the changes made since the session went
  online. The states from before it can hold the person's offline work,
  including images that never went into the session. A step into them answers
  `CONFLICT_BEFORE_SESSION`.
- Images travel as bytes. `look`, and `call` with `getThumbnail`,
  `getCanvasImageBytes` or `getLayerThumbnail`, add the image to the session
  as its own bytes. In place of base64 `bytes`, the result has
  `image: { id, mimeType, bytes }`, where `id` is the SHA-256 of the image and
  `bytes` is its size. The tool saves the image as a file and adds its `path`.
- To add an image to the composition, add the file with `image-put`, then
  name it as `image:<sha256>`:
  `call pasteImageFromBytes '{"source":{"kind":"url","value":"image:<sha256>"}}'`
  (or `addLayer` with `kind: "media"`, `mediaType: "image"` and the same
  `source`). A request that carries an image as base64 text answers
  `IMAGE_AS_TEXT`. A request that names media by any other link answers
  `OUTSIDE_LINK`, because the person's browser would fetch it.
- A session holds at most 32 images, and the composition's own images and
  masks need room too. The tab takes at most 16 images in ten minutes; past
  that, image commands answer `IMAGE_LIMIT` with `details.retryAfter` in
  seconds. Look when the composition has changed, not in a loop.
- A session cannot hold video layers.

Agent tool errors (exit code 2, `error.code`):

- `NO_SESSION`: no session is joined, or more than one and none was named.
- `UNKNOWN_SESSION`, `SESSION_LOCKED`, `REFUSED`: the session code is wrong or
  expired, the session is locked, or the session refused the join.
- `NO_APP_TAB`: the tab that took the session online did not answer. Ask the
  person to keep it open, or to go online again and send the new code.
- `TIMEOUT`: the tab did not answer in time. Check `status`, then try again.
- `READONLY`: the session lets this agent only watch: `wait` and `status`
  work, and every app command, `commands` and `look` included, is refused.
  Ask the person to allow guests to edit.
- `SESSION_CLOSED`, `SESSION_REFUSED`: the connection closed, or the session
  server refused a request (the message says why).
- `ISLAND`: a `transfer` to or from a Layers session. Layers shares nothing
  with other apps.
- `IMAGE_FAILED`, `NO_DOCUMENT`, `USAGE`, `INVALID_JSON`: an image transfer
  failed, a document is missing, or the command line was wrong.
- `CONNECT_FAILED`, `RATE_LIMITED`: `join` could not reach the session server,
  or the server is limiting joins from this address. Wait a minute, then join
  again.
- `INVALID_IMAGE`, `BAD_RESPONSE`: an image id is malformed, or the app sent
  an answer that the tool could not read.
- `DAEMON_FAILED`, `INTERNAL_ERROR`: the tool's background process did not
  start, or the tool failed. If it happens again, run `stop` and join again.
- A file that the tool cannot read gives the system's code, such as `ENOENT`.

## Control Layers in a browser you drive

Use this route when you control a browser yourself. Its API exists only in
the page. You need a browser tool that can run JavaScript in a page.
A tool that only fetches HTML cannot use Layers.

1. Open https://layers.noisefactor.io in your browser tool.
2. Run JavaScript in the page. Wait for `window.LayersAgent.ready`.
3. Call commands. Every command is an async method that returns an envelope.

```js
await window.LayersAgent.ready                       // resolves once bootstrap is done
const v = window.LayersAgent.version                  // current API version (e.g. "1.0")
const env = await window.LayersAgent.getState({})     // any command
```

The document is in that page. To keep your work, call `saveProject({ name })`.
`saveProject` writes the project to the storage of that browser.

---

## Keep results small

Your browser tool sends each script result back to you.
A large result uses a large part of your context.

- Return only the fields that you need from each script.
- Every envelope includes the full `state`. Remove it when you do not need it.
- `exportImage` always returns the full image as base64 in `result.bytes`.
  Remove `bytes` before you return the envelope, unless you need the bytes.
  To get only the bytes, without a download, pass `triggerDownload: false`.
- To look at the canvas, call `getThumbnail`. By default, its longest side is 256 pixels.
- The agent tool saves images as files and prints only their paths. Open a
  file with your image tool; do not print its bytes.

```js
const env = await LayersAgent.exportImage({ format: 'png' })   // starts the download
const { bytes, ...result } = env.result
return { ok: env.ok, result }
```

---

## The envelope

Every command response -- success or failure -- has this shape:

```js
// success
{
    ok: true,
    command: "getState",
    apiVersion: "1.0",
    result: { /* command-specific */ },
    state: { /* full state snapshot */ },
    warnings: [{ code: "...", message: "..." }]  // optional
}

// failure
{
    ok: false,
    command: "addLayer",
    apiVersion: "1.0",
    error: {
        code: "INVALID_ARGS_ENUM",
        message: "Unknown kind: ...",
        details: { field: "kind", got: "foo" }
    },
    state: { /* full state snapshot */ }
}
```

**Every response includes state, whether the command succeeds or fails.**
Read `env.state` after each mutation. A separate `getState` call is unnecessary.

---

## Warnings

`env.warnings`, when present on a success envelope, is an array of structured
objects (not plain strings):

```js
{
    code:    "UNKNOWN_SETTING_KEY",     // stable identifier; agents can switch on this
    key:     "foo",                      // optional; the offending field if applicable
    message: "unknown setting key: foo (ignored)"  // human-readable
}
```

The response includes `warnings` only when the array is non-empty.
Handle unknown warning codes. New codes may appear without an `apiVersion` change.

Examples:
- `UNKNOWN_SETTING_KEY` from `setSettings` -- the key was ignored
- `THEME_PERSIST_FAILED` from `setSettings` -- localStorage write threw
- `PROJECT_STORAGE_ERROR` from `listProjects` -- the storage layer threw an exception.
  The command returned the available result, usually an empty list.
- `SESSION_TAKEN_OFFLINE` from `newProject`/`openProject` -- an online Seance
  session went offline first. These commands replace the whole composition,
  which a shared session cannot represent.

---

## State snapshot shape

```
state: {
    apiVersion, schemaVersion,
    project:        { id, name, isDirty, canUndo, canRedo, canSaveAs },
    canvas:         { width, height },
    view:           { zoomMode, tool, selectionTool, maskEditLayerId,
                      maskOverlayLayerId, scrollX, scrollY,
                      scrollMaxX, scrollMaxY, isPlaying, loopDuration },
    foreground:     { color },
    selection:      null | { kind, bounds, isEmpty, polygonPoints?, mask? },
    layers:         [{ id, name, sourceType, visible, opacity, blendMode,
                       locked, transform, media, effect,
                       drawing: { strokeCount, strokeIds, strokeIdsTruncated } | null,
                       children: [{ id, name, effectId, visible, params, mask }],
                       mask }],
    selectedLayerIds, activeLayerId,
    jobs:           [{ id, kind, status, startedAt, updatedAt, completedAt,
                       progress, result, error }],   // most recent 20
    recentExports:  [{ id, kind, filename, mimeType, sizeBytes, createdAt }],
    settings:       { theme?, exportImage?, exportVideo? },
    collaboration:  { available, status, sessionId, shareUrl }
}
```

Through a session, the state has no `foreground`, `jobs`, `recentExports` or
`settings`, `project` is `{ canUndo, canRedo }`, and `media` has no `filename`.

`sourceType` is one of `effect | drawing | media | text`. `selection.kind` is
`rectangle | oval | lasso | polygon | wand | color-range`. `jobs.status` is
`queued | running | succeeded | failed | cancelled`.
`mask` on a layer or child effect is null or a summary with `width`, `height`,
`coverage`, and `bounds`. A layer mask also has `enabled` and `visible`.
Raster selections have the same summary in `selection.mask`. Use
`getRasterRegion` for exact pixels in a browser you drive; a session cannot
read them. Summaries do not contain pixel arrays.

---

## Tool discovery

llms-full.txt lists every command with a description and its arguments.
You can also read the same data from the page:

```js
// Every public command
const commands = Object.keys(window.LayersAgent)
    .filter(k => typeof window.LayersAgent[k] === 'function' && !k.startsWith('_'))

// A one-line description of each command, in groups
const { COMMAND_GROUPS } = await import('/js/agent/descriptions.js')

// The argument schema of each command that takes arguments
const { SCHEMAS } = await import('/js/agent/schemas.js')
console.log(SCHEMAS.addLayer)
// -> { type:'object', properties:{ kind:{type:'string', enum:[...]}, ... }, required:['kind'] }
```

A command whose `SCHEMAS` entry is null takes no arguments.
Skip `_`-prefixed names. They are not public commands.

New commands and nested layer, transform, and child property objects reject
undeclared keys with `INVALID_ARGS_UNKNOWN`. Most existing command argument roots
remain permissive for compatibility; `llms-full.txt` marks closed schemas.
Free-form effect parameter and media source objects remain open.
`setSettings` keeps its `UNKNOWN_SETTING_KEY` warning for unknown settings.

The commands cover these operations:

- Create, read, update, and delete layers. Set layer properties and transforms.
- Set effect parameters and child effects.
- Draw with `paintStroke` and `drawShape`. Read existing strokes with
  `getDrawingStrokes`. Fill an area with `fillRegion`. Read and paint masks.
- Create and modify rectangle, oval, polygon, lasso, wand, and color-range selections.
- Manage projects, undo, and redo.
- Control the view, foreground, toolbar tool, selection tool, pan, settings,
  zoom, and playback.
- Resize the canvas or image. Adjust levels, contrast, and white balance automatically.
- Export images and videos. Install and list fonts. Manage jobs.

---

## Error codes

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| `INVALID_ARGS_TYPE` | wrong type |
| `INVALID_ARGS_REQUIRED` | missing required field |
| `INVALID_ARGS_RANGE` | number, string length or item count out of range |
| `INVALID_ARGS_ENUM` | not in allowed enum |
| `INVALID_ARGS_UNKNOWN` | an undeclared field on a strict command (llms-full.txt names them), or an effect parameter that the effect does not declare |
| `NOT_FOUND_LAYER` | unknown layer id or child effect id |
| `NOT_FOUND_STROKE` | unknown stroke id on a drawing layer (`eraseStroke`) |
| `NOT_FOUND_EFFECT` | unknown effect id (from `getEffectDefinition`, `details` includes `didYouMean`) |
| `NOT_FOUND_JOB` | unknown job id |
| `NOT_FOUND_PROJECT` | unknown project id |
| `NOT_FOUND_EXPORT` | `releaseExport` got an id that has no `captureOnly` video URL |
| `CONFLICT_BASE_LAYER` | `deleteLayer` or `reorderLayer` tried to change the base layer, or to move a layer to index 0 |
| `CONFLICT_DUPLICATE_FAILED` | the app could not duplicate the layer |
| `CONFLICT_TOOL_BLOCKED_FOR_TYPE` | the command does not support this layer type (`flipLayer` on a layer that is not media) |
| `CONFLICT_NOT_TRANSFORMABLE_LAYER` | the layer has no raster source to transform |
| `CONFLICT_NOT_EFFECT_LAYER` | the layer is not an effect layer |
| `CONFLICT_NOT_DRAWING_LAYER` | the layer is not a drawing layer |
| `CONFLICT_NO_SELECTION` | the command needs an active selection |
| `CONFLICT_LAYER_HAS_MASK` | the layer already has a mask |
| `CONFLICT_NO_MASK` | the layer has no mask |
| `CONFLICT_MEDIA_BLOCKED_ONLINE` | a video layer while a collaboration session is online |
| `CONFLICT_PROJECT_REPLACEMENT` | `newProject` or `openProject` did not complete (`details.status` gives the reason) |
| `NOT_FOUND_RECOVERY` | a recovery copy id is no longer available |
| `CONFLICT_RECOVERY_IN_USE` | another browser tab owns that recovery copy |
| `CONFLICT_FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE` | online collaboration is disabled in this build |
| `CONFLICT_SESSION_TRANSITION` | taking the project online or joining a session did not complete |
| `CONFLICT_JOB_IN_PROGRESS` | a duplicate job is already running (e.g. installFontBundle) |
| `JOB_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` | too many active jobs (cap = 20) |
| `JOB_CANCELLED` | the job was cancelled (terminal state, not an error per se) |
| `RESOURCE_DECODE_FAILED` | base64 / URL fetch / image decode failed, or the online session has no image `image:<sha256>` |
| `RENDER_LAYER_COMPOSITE_FAILED` | the renderer could not isolate the layer (`getLayerThumbnail`) |
| `NOT_FOUND_COMMAND` | a session request named a command that Layers does not have |
| `REMOTE_UNAVAILABLE` | the command needs the person at the browser, and came through a session |
| `CONFLICT_SESSION_ENDED` | the session that sent the command was no longer online in the tab when the command's turn came; the command did not run |
| `CONFLICT_BEFORE_SESSION` | through a session, `undo` or `redo` would restore a state from before the session went online |
| `IMAGE_LIMIT` | the tab already took 16 images in ten minutes. `details.retryAfter` is in seconds |
| `IMAGE_AS_TEXT` | a session request or answer would carry an image as base64 text. Add the image with `image-put` and use `image:<sha256>` |
| `OUTSIDE_LINK` | a session request names media by a link other than `image:<sha256>` |
| `IMAGE_UPLOAD_FAILED` | the tab could not add an image to the session (a session holds up to 32 images of up to 8 MiB each) |
| `INTERNAL_ERROR` | unexpected handler throw. Through a session it also means the session rejected a change that the tab already made; read the state before trying again |

`details` usually names the field or value that caused the error. Some conflict
errors send an empty `details`. From `getEffectDefinition`, `NOT_FOUND_EFFECT`
also gives `details.didYouMean`: the 3 closest effect ids by Levenshtein distance.

---

## Jobs (long-running operations)

Some commands return immediately with a `jobId` and run in the background:

- `installFontBundle` -- downloads ~140 MB font bundle into IndexedDB
- `exportVideo` -- frame-by-frame video encode (can take minutes for long clips)

Pattern (in-page):

```js
const { result: { jobId } } = await LayersAgent.exportVideo({
    width: 1024, height: 1024, framerate: 30, duration: 5,
    format: 'mp4', quality: 'high'
})

// Poll
const job = (await LayersAgent.getJob({ jobId })).result
// { id, kind, status, progress:{phase, current, total, message}, result, error }

// Or block
const settled = (await LayersAgent.waitForJob({ jobId, timeoutMs: 120000 })).result
// settled.status === 'succeeded' | 'failed' | 'cancelled', plus settled.timedOut if applicable

// Cancel
await LayersAgent.cancelJob({ jobId })
```

A timeout is not a failure. `waitForJob` then returns `ok: true` and the job
with `timedOut: true`. Check `timedOut` before you read `status`.
Without `timeoutMs`, or with `timeoutMs: 0`, `waitForJob` waits with no limit.

Your browser tool can stop a script that runs too long.
For a long job, call `waitForJob` with a short `timeoutMs`.
Repeat the call while the result has `timedOut: true`.
A settled job has no `timedOut` field.

A failed job has `status: 'failed'` and `error: { code, message, details }`.
These codes appear in `error.code`:

| Code | When |
|---|---|
| `JOB_FAILED` | the job failed, and no specific code applies |
| `VIDEO_EXPORT_ENCODE_FAILED` | the MP4 encoder failed. Try a lower resolution or `format: 'zip'` |
| `VIDEO_EXPORT_EMPTY` | the MP4 export produced no video data |
| `VIDEO_DURATION_UNAVAILABLE` | a video layer has no finite duration |
| `CONFLICT_EXPORT_IN_PROGRESS` | a video export from the editor dialog is running |

A cancelled job has `status: 'cancelled'` and `error.code` `JOB_CANCELLED`.

`JOB_KINDS` is exported from `/js/agent/jobs.js`:

```js
import { JOB_KINDS } from '/js/agent/jobs.js'
// JOB_KINDS.INSTALL_FONT_BUNDLE === 'install-font-bundle'
// JOB_KINDS.EXPORT_VIDEO === 'export-video'
```

`installFontBundle` passes AbortSignal to the loader's fetch and extraction calls.
Cancellation takes effect at chunk or font boundaries.
A single font extraction cannot be interrupted.
JSZip extracts a variable font of 5+ MB in one call.
Cancellation during that call may take several seconds.

`exportVideo` checks for cancellation at every frame boundary and before encoder finalization.

---

## Exports & downloads

`exportImage` and `exportVideo` both record an entry into `state.recentExports`:

```js
{ id, kind: 'image'|'video', filename, mimeType, sizeBytes, createdAt }
```

By default, both commands start a browser download.
The browser puts the file in its download folder.
A downloaded image uses the `filename` of its export entry.
Layers names a downloaded video `layers-<time>.mp4` or `layers-<time>.zip`.
Its export entry `filename` applies only to a `captureOnly` export.

`exportImage` also returns the image as base64 in `result.bytes`, with or
without the download. `triggerDownload: false` skips the download.

### captureOnly + releaseExport

`captureOnly: true` skips the browser download on both commands.

In captureOnly mode, `exportImage` returns `result.bytes` as a base64-encoded
image, plus an `exportId`. There is no blob URL to release.

`exportVideo({captureOnly: true})` gives a completed job with `result.result.blobUrl` and an `exportId`.
The envelope omits the raw Blob because envelopes must be JSON-serializable.
The `blobUrl` remains valid until the page unloads or the agent calls `releaseExport({exportId})`.
After you read the video bytes, call `releaseExport({exportId})` to free its memory.
Otherwise, the Blob remains in memory for the rest of the page's lifetime.

```js
const env = await LayersAgent.exportVideo({ format: 'mp4', captureOnly: true, ... })
const settled = await LayersAgent.waitForJob({ jobId: env.result.jobId, timeoutMs: 60000 })
// Repeat waitForJob while settled.result.timedOut is true.
const { blobUrl, exportId } = settled.result.result
const bytes = await (await fetch(blobUrl)).arrayBuffer()
await LayersAgent.releaseExport({ exportId })   // frees the Blob
```

`releaseExport` with an image `exportId` fails with `NOT_FOUND_EXPORT`.

---

## Patterns

**Run a command and react to state:**

```js
const env = await LayersAgent.addLayer({ kind: 'effect', effectId: 'synth/gradient' })
if (!env.ok) throw new Error(`${env.error.code}: ${env.error.message}`)
const newLayerId = env.result.layerId
// `env.state.layers` already includes the new layer; no extra getState call.
```

**Discover an effect:**

```js
const env = await LayersAgent.searchEffects({ query: 'noise' })
// env.result.effects is a list of { effectId, namespace, name, description, tags, ... }
const def = (await LayersAgent.getEffectDefinition({ effectId: 'synth/gradient' })).result
// def is { effectId, name, namespace, description, tags, params }
```

**Show a layer only inside a rectangle:**

```js
await LayersAgent.setRectangleSelection({ x: 50, y: 50, width: 200, height: 200 })
await LayersAgent.addMaskFromSelection({ layerId: '...' })
```

**Inspect and edit existing drawing and mask content:**

```js
const layerId = '...'
const layer = (await LayersAgent.getLayer({ layerId })).result
// layer.drawing.strokeIds lists the first 20 ids; page through all strokes below.
const page = (await LayersAgent.getDrawingStrokes({ layerId, limit: 20 })).result
// Follow page.nextOffset until it is null; strokes include their geometry.

const tile = (await LayersAgent.getRasterRegion({
    source: 'layer-mask', layerId, x: 0, y: 0, width: 64, height: 64
})).result
// tile.values is row-major, one grayscale value per pixel (0 hides, 255 reveals).
await LayersAgent.paintLayerMask({
    layerId, mode: 'hide', points: [[10, 10], [30, 30]], size: 8
})
```

For `getRasterRegion`, `source` can be `selection`, `layer-mask`, or
`child-mask`. A child mask also needs `childId`. Read large rasters in tiles of
at most 256 by 256 pixels. Selection pixels use alpha values; layer and child
masks use grayscale values. A child effect captures the active selection when
it is added; `deleteChildEffectMask` removes that captured mask.

When online collaboration is enabled, `takeOnline` starts a shared session and
`joinSession({sessionId})` joins one. Joining replaces the current composition
without a dialog; save work first if needed. `goOffline` leaves the session.
Read `state.collaboration` for availability, status, session id, and share URL.

**Recover unsaved work:**

```js
const { copies } = (await LayersAgent.listRecoveryCopies()).result
if (copies.length) {
    const restored = await LayersAgent.restoreRecoveryCopy({ id: copies[0].id })
    if (!restored.ok) throw new Error(restored.error.message)
}
```

`restoreRecoveryCopy` replaces the current composition. `discardRecoveryCopy`
permanently removes a copy by id. Each list entry reports its name, dimensions,
layer count, and modification time without returning embedded media.

**Look at the canvas:**

```js
const env = await LayersAgent.getThumbnail({ maxDimension: 512, format: 'png' })
return env.result   // { bytes, mimeType, format, width, height, sizeBytes }
```

---

## Caveats

**Font registration is async.** If a layer's requested `font` is not registered
in the browser, the first render uses Nunito as the fallback.
Layers renders again after the font loads.
The agent's snapshot reports the requested font immediately.
The rendered pixels still use the fallback for at least one frame.

To read output with the requested font, first call `installFontBundle` if the font is in the fontaine bundle.
Alternatively, wait for one or two `getThumbnail` calls before reading bytes.

---

## Pointers

- Full command reference: https://layers.noisefactor.io/llms-full.txt
- Source of truth: `/js/agent/index.js` (registration), `/js/agent/commands.js`
  (handlers), `/js/agent/schemas.js` (input schemas), `/js/agent/descriptions.js`
  (command descriptions), `/js/agent/jobs.js` (job registry + `JOB_KINDS`),
  `/js/agent/snapshot.js` (state builder), `/js/agent/session.js` (what a
  session sees and may run), `/js/agent/relay.js` (the session relay)
- Test/diagnostic back door: `window.__LAYERS_TEST_HOOKS.jobs` (Playwright
  specs only -- NOT a public API)

---

## Command reference

Layers has 103 public commands. Call a command as `await window.LayersAgent.<name>(args)`.
You can omit the argument object: `getState()` is the same as `getState({})`.

### Read state

#### `getState`

Returns the full state snapshot. Every envelope already includes it in `state`.

Arguments: none.

#### `getLayer`

Returns the snapshot of one layer.

Arguments:

- `layerId` (required): string

#### `getCanvasSize`

Returns the canvas width and height in pixels.

Arguments: none.

#### `getSelection`

Returns the active selection (kind, bounds, optional polygon points), or null when there is no selection.

Arguments: none.

#### `getProjectInfo`

Returns the project part of the snapshot: id, name, isDirty, canUndo, canRedo and canSaveAs.

Not available through a session: it answers `REMOTE_UNAVAILABLE`.

Arguments: none.

#### `listProjects`

Lists the projects saved in this browser, with id, name, createdAt and modifiedAt.

Not available through a session: it answers `REMOTE_UNAVAILABLE`.

Arguments: none.

#### `getSettings`

Returns the theme and export presets that this browser stores.

Not available through a session: it answers `REMOTE_UNAVAILABLE`.

Arguments: none.

#### `getForegroundColor`

Returns `{color}`, where `color` is a `#rrggbb` string.

Not available through a session: it answers `REMOTE_UNAVAILABLE`.

Arguments: none.

### Find effects

#### `searchEffects`

Searches the effect catalog. `query` matches a substring, every tag in `tags` must match, and `limit` sets the maximum count.

Arguments:

- `query`: string
- `namespace`: string
- `tags`: array of strings
- `limit`: integer, from 1 to 1000

#### `listEffectCategories`

Returns every namespace and tag in the effect catalog.

Arguments: none.

#### `listCuratedEffects`

Returns the effect groups that the Image and Filter menus show.

Arguments: none.

#### `getEffectDefinition`

Returns the parameters of one effect: name, type, default, range and allowed values.

Arguments:

- `effectId` (required): string

### Jobs

#### `getJob`

Returns the current state of a job: status, progress, and the result or error.

Not available through a session: it answers `REMOTE_UNAVAILABLE`.

Arguments:

- `jobId` (required): string

#### `waitForJob`

Waits until a job settles or `timeoutMs` passes. A timeout returns `ok: true` with `result.timedOut: true`.

Not available through a session: it answers `REMOTE_UNAVAILABLE`.

Arguments:

- `jobId` (required): string
- `timeoutMs`: integer, from 0 to 3600000

#### `cancelJob`

Asks a running job to stop. The job stops at its next check, for example between video frames.

Not available through a session: it answers `REMOTE_UNAVAILABLE`.

Arguments:

- `jobId` (required): string

### Layers

#### `addLayer`

Adds a layer and returns its id. `kind` is effect (needs `effectId`), drawing, media (needs `source` and `mediaType`) or text (needs `text`). `source` has the same shape as in pasteImageFromBytes.

Arguments:

- `kind` (required): string, one of `effect`, `drawing`, `media`, `text`
- `effectId`: string
- `params`: object
- `name`: string
- `text`: string
- `mediaType`: string, one of `image`, `video`
- `source`: object

#### `deleteLayer`

Deletes a layer. The base layer at index 0 cannot be deleted.

Arguments:

- `layerId` (required): string

#### `duplicateLayer`

Duplicates a layer, selects the copy, and returns its id.

Arguments:

- `layerId` (required): string

#### `reorderLayer`

Moves a layer to `toIndex`. Index 0 is the base layer at the bottom. The base layer cannot move, and no layer can move to index 0.

Arguments:

- `layerId` (required): string
- `toIndex` (required): integer, 0 or more

#### `selectLayer`

Makes one layer the active layer.

Arguments:

- `layerId` (required): string

#### `selectLayers`

Selects the given layers. The first id becomes the active layer.

Arguments:

- `layerIds` (required): array of strings

#### `flattenImage`

Merges all layers into one media layer.

Arguments: none.

#### `flattenLayers`

Merges two or more given layers into one raster layer. The other layers do not change.

Arguments:

- `layerIds` (required): array of strings

#### `rasterizeLayer`

Changes an effect or drawing layer into a media layer with its current pixels. The layer loses its effect parameters or strokes.

Arguments:

- `layerId` (required): string

#### `flipLayer`

Flips a media layer horizontally (`h`) or vertically (`v`). Other layer types are not supported.

Arguments:

- `layerId` (required): string
- `axis` (required): string, one of `h`, `v`

#### `setLayerProps`

Sets the name, visible, opacity, blendMode or locked property of a layer.

Arguments:

- `layerId` (required): string
- `props` (required): object with only these fields
  - `name`: string
  - `visible`: boolean
  - `opacity`: number, from 0 to 100
  - `blendMode`: string, one of `mix`, `multiply`, `screen`, `overlay`, `softLight`, `hardLight`, `darken`, `lighten`, `dodge`, `burn`, `add`, `subtract`, `difference`, `exclusion`, `negation`, `phoenix`
  - `locked`: boolean

#### `setLayerTransform`

Sets the offset, scale, rotation or flip of a layer. Only media and drawing layers accept a transform.

Arguments:

- `layerId` (required): string
- `transform` (required): object with only these fields
  - `offsetX`: number
  - `offsetY`: number
  - `scaleX`: number, from 0.01 to 100
  - `scaleY`: number, from 0.01 to 100
  - `rotation`: number
  - `flipH`: boolean
  - `flipV`: boolean

### Effect parameters and child effects

#### `setLayerEffectParams`

Changes the parameters of an effect layer. The new values merge into the old values. `replace: true` clears the old values first.

Arguments:

- `layerId` (required): string
- `params` (required): object
- `replace`: boolean

#### `addChildEffect`

Adds a child effect to a layer and returns its id. A child effect applies on top of the output of its layer.

Arguments:

- `layerId` (required): string
- `effectId` (required): string
- `params`: object

#### `removeChildEffect`

Removes a child effect from a layer.

Arguments:

- `layerId` (required): string
- `childId` (required): string

#### `reorderChildEffect`

Moves a child effect to `toIndex` in the child list of its layer.

Arguments:

- `layerId` (required): string
- `childId` (required): string
- `toIndex` (required): integer, 0 or more

#### `setChildEffectProps`

Sets the `visible` or `name` property of a child effect. Unknown keys fail validation.

Arguments:

- `layerId` (required): string
- `childId` (required): string
- `props` (required): object with only these fields
  - `visible`: boolean
  - `name`: string

#### `setChildEffectParams`

Changes the parameters of a child effect. The new values merge into the old values. `replace: true` clears the old values first.

Arguments:

- `layerId` (required): string
- `childId` (required): string
- `params` (required): object
- `replace`: boolean

#### `deleteChildEffectMask`

Removes the selection mask captured when a child effect was added.

Arguments:

- `layerId` (required): string
- `childId` (required): string

Other fields fail with `INVALID_ARGS_UNKNOWN`.

### Images and export

#### `getCanvasImageBytes`

Returns the full-size canvas as base64 image data. No download starts. Through a session, the image goes into the session as its own bytes, and `image` replaces `bytes`.

Arguments:

- `format`: string, one of `png`, `jpg`, `webp`
- `quality`: number, from 0 to 1

#### `getThumbnail`

Returns a small canvas image as base64 data. The longest side is `maxDimension` (default 256). Through a session, the image goes into the session as its own bytes, and `image` replaces `bytes`.

Arguments:

- `maxDimension`: integer, from 1 to 4096
- `format`: string, one of `png`, `jpg`, `webp`
- `quality`: number, from 0 to 1

#### `getLayerThumbnail`

Returns a small image of one layer, with its child effects and mask, as base64 data. Through a session, the image goes into the session as its own bytes, and `image` replaces `bytes`.

Arguments:

- `layerId` (required): string
- `maxDimension`: integer, from 1 to 4096
- `format`: string, one of `png`, `jpg`, `webp`
- `quality`: number, from 0 to 1

#### `exportImage`

Exports the canvas as an image. By default, it starts a browser download. The result always includes the image as base64 in `bytes`.

Not available through a session: it answers `REMOTE_UNAVAILABLE`.

Arguments:

- `format`: string, one of `png`, `jpg`, `webp`
- `quality`: number, from 0 to 1
- `width`: integer, from 1 to 8192
- `height`: integer, from 1 to 8192
- `filename`: string
- `triggerDownload`: boolean
- `captureOnly`: boolean

#### `pasteImageFromBytes`

Adds an image as a new media layer. `source` is `{kind: "base64", data, mimeType?}` or `{kind: "url", value}`. `data` is raw base64, without a `data:` prefix. While a session is online, `value` can be `image:<sha256>`, an image in the session. Through a session, only that form is accepted.

Arguments:

- `source` (required): object
- `name`: string

#### `exportVideo`

Starts a video export job (MP4, or a ZIP of PNG frames) and returns its `jobId`. The file downloads when the job succeeds.

Not available through a session: it answers `REMOTE_UNAVAILABLE`.

Arguments:

- `width`: integer, from 2 to 4096
- `height`: integer, from 2 to 4096
- `framerate`: integer, one of `24`, `30`, `60`
- `duration`: number, from 0.1 to 300
- `loopCount`: integer, from 1 to 10
- `format`: string, one of `mp4`, `zip`
- `quality`: string, one of `low`, `medium`, `high`, `very high`, `ultra`
- `playFrom`: string, one of `beginning`, `current`
- `filename`: string
- `captureOnly`: boolean

Other fields fail with `INVALID_ARGS_UNKNOWN`.

#### `releaseExport`

Frees the blob URL of a `captureOnly` video export. Call it after you read the bytes.

Not available through a session: it answers `REMOTE_UNAVAILABLE`.

Arguments:

- `exportId` (required): string, at least 1 character

Other fields fail with `INVALID_ARGS_UNKNOWN`.

### Selections

#### `selectAll`

Selects the whole canvas.

Arguments: none.

#### `selectNone`

Clears the selection.

Arguments: none.

#### `selectInverse`

Inverts the selection. A selection must be active.

Arguments: none.

#### `setRectangleSelection`

Selects a rectangle from its top-left corner, width and height.

Arguments:

- `x` (required): integer
- `y` (required): integer
- `width` (required): integer, 1 or more
- `height` (required): integer, 1 or more

#### `setOvalSelection`

Selects the oval inside the given rectangle.

Arguments:

- `x` (required): integer
- `y` (required): integer
- `width` (required): integer, 1 or more
- `height` (required): integer, 1 or more

#### `setPolygonSelection`

Selects a polygon or lasso shape from 3 or more points. Each point is `[x, y]`.

Arguments:

- `kind`: string, one of `polygon`, `lasso`
- `points` (required): array, each item array of numbers

#### `setMagicWandSelection`

Selects the connected pixels with a color near the color at (x, y). `tolerance` is 0 to 255 (default 32).

Arguments:

- `x` (required): integer, 0 or more
- `y` (required): integer, 0 or more
- `tolerance`: integer, from 0 to 255

#### `selectColorRange`

Selects every pixel with a color near the color at (x, y), connected or not. `tolerance` defaults to 32.

Arguments:

- `x` (required): integer, 0 or more
- `y` (required): integer, 0 or more
- `tolerance`: integer, from 0 to 255

#### `expandSelection`

Grows the selection by `pixels`.

Arguments:

- `pixels` (required): integer, from 1 to 1000

#### `contractSelection`

Shrinks the selection by `pixels`.

Arguments:

- `pixels` (required): integer, from 1 to 1000

#### `featherSelection`

Softens the selection edge over `pixels`.

Arguments:

- `pixels` (required): integer, from 1 to 1000

#### `smoothSelection`

Smooths rough selection edges with a blur of `pixels`.

Arguments:

- `pixels` (required): integer, from 1 to 1000

#### `borderSelection`

Replaces the selection with a band, `pixels` wide, inside its edge.

Arguments:

- `pixels` (required): integer, from 1 to 1000

#### `cropToSelection`

Crops the image and canvas to the bounding box of the selection.

Arguments: none.

### Masks

#### `addLayerMask`

Adds a white mask to a layer. A white mask shows the full layer.

Arguments:

- `layerId` (required): string

#### `deleteLayerMask`

Removes the mask of a layer. The layer pixels do not change.

Arguments:

- `layerId` (required): string

#### `addMaskFromSelection`

Adds a mask to a layer. The mask starts as a copy of the current selection.

Arguments:

- `layerId` (required): string

#### `selectFromLayerMask`

Creates a raster selection from the visible values of a layer mask.

Arguments:

- `layerId` (required): string

Other fields fail with `INVALID_ARGS_UNKNOWN`.

#### `getRasterRegion`

Reads up to 256 by 256 grayscale values from a selection, layer mask, or child effect mask. `values` is row-major. Pass `layerId` for a layer mask, and both `layerId` and `childId` for a child mask.

Not available through a session: it answers `REMOTE_UNAVAILABLE`.

Arguments:

- `source` (required): string, one of `selection`, `layer-mask`, `child-mask`
- `layerId`: string
- `childId`: string
- `x` (required): integer, 0 or more
- `y` (required): integer, 0 or more
- `width` (required): integer, from 1 to 256
- `height` (required): integer, from 1 to 256

Other fields fail with `INVALID_ARGS_UNKNOWN`.

#### `paintLayerMask`

Paints a stroke on a layer mask in canvas coordinates. `mode` is `hide` (black) or `reveal` (white).

Arguments:

- `layerId` (required): string
- `points` (required): array
- `size` (required): integer, from 1 to 200
- `opacity`: number, from 0 to 1
- `mode` (required): string, one of `hide`, `reveal`

Other fields fail with `INVALID_ARGS_UNKNOWN`.

#### `invertLayerMask`

Inverts the mask of a layer.

Arguments:

- `layerId` (required): string

#### `setMaskEnabled`

Turns the mask of a layer on or off. A disabled mask stays on the layer.

Arguments:

- `layerId` (required): string
- `enabled` (required): boolean

#### `setMaskVisible`

Shows or hides the layer mask overlay without changing its effect on the image. Only one overlay can be shown; read its owner from `state.view.maskOverlayLayerId`.

Arguments:

- `layerId` (required): string
- `visible` (required): boolean

Other fields fail with `INVALID_ARGS_UNKNOWN`.

#### `setMaskEditMode`

Enters the existing mask brush mode with `enabled: true, layerId`, or exits it with `enabled: false`. The active mask edit layer is in `state.view.maskEditLayerId`.

Arguments:

- `enabled` (required): boolean
- `layerId`: string, at least 1 character

Other fields fail with `INVALID_ARGS_UNKNOWN`.

#### `featherMask`

Softens the mask edge over `radius` pixels.

Arguments:

- `layerId` (required): string
- `radius` (required): integer, from 1 to 100

#### `expandMask`

Grows the mask by `radius` pixels.

Arguments:

- `layerId` (required): string
- `radius` (required): integer, from 1 to 100

#### `contractMask`

Shrinks the mask by `radius` pixels.

Arguments:

- `layerId` (required): string
- `radius` (required): integer, from 1 to 100

#### `smoothMask`

Smooths rough mask edges with a blur of `radius` pixels.

Arguments:

- `layerId` (required): string
- `radius` (required): integer, from 1 to 100

### Drawing

#### `paintStroke`

Paints a stroke through 2 or more `points` (`[x, y]` or `{x, y}`) on a drawing layer. With `mode: "eraser"`, the stroke paints transparency. Without `layerId`, see drawShape.

Arguments:

- `layerId`: string
- `points` (required): array
- `size` (required): integer, from 1 to 200
- `opacity`: number, from 0 to 1
- `color` (required): string
- `mode`: string, one of `brush`, `eraser`

#### `getDrawingStrokes`

Returns up to `limit` editable strokes (default 100) from `offset` (default 0), including ids and geometry. `nextOffset` is null on the last page.

Arguments:

- `layerId` (required): string
- `offset`: integer, 0 or more
- `limit`: integer, from 1 to 100

Other fields fail with `INVALID_ARGS_UNKNOWN`.

#### `eraseStroke`

Removes one stroke, by its `strokeId`, from a drawing layer.

Arguments:

- `layerId` (required): string, at least 1 character
- `strokeId` (required): string, at least 1 character

#### `clearDrawingLayer`

Removes all strokes from a drawing layer and returns the number it removed.

Arguments:

- `layerId` (required): string, at least 1 character

#### `drawShape`

Draws a rectangle or ellipse, filled or outlined, on a drawing layer. Without `layerId`, it uses the active layer if that is a drawing layer. Otherwise it adds a drawing layer above the active layer.

Arguments:

- `layerId`: string
- `shape` (required): string, one of `rect`, `ellipse`
- `x` (required): integer
- `y` (required): integer
- `width` (required): integer, 1 or more
- `height` (required): integer, 1 or more
- `color` (required): string
- `size` (required): integer, from 1 to 200
- `opacity`: number, from 0 to 1
- `filled`: boolean

#### `fillRegion`

Adds a media layer of `color` in the shape of the connected area with a color near the color at (x, y). The new layer has no mask.

Arguments:

- `x` (required): integer, 0 or more
- `y` (required): integer, 0 or more
- `color` (required): string
- `tolerance`: integer, from 0 to 255

### Projects and history

#### `newProject`

Starts a new empty project at the given size. It discards unsaved changes without a warning.

Not available through a session: it answers `REMOTE_UNAVAILABLE`.

Arguments:

- `width` (required): integer, from 1 to 8192
- `height` (required): integer, from 1 to 8192
- `name`: string

#### `openProject`

Opens a saved project in place of the current project.

Not available through a session: it answers `REMOTE_UNAVAILABLE`.

Arguments:

- `projectId` (required): string, at least 1 character

#### `saveProject`

Saves the current project. `name` renames it. When the project has no name yet, `name` is necessary.

Not available through a session: it answers `REMOTE_UNAVAILABLE`.

Arguments:

- `name`: string, at least 1 character

#### `saveProjectAs`

Saves the current state as a new project named `name` and returns its id.

Not available through a session: it answers `REMOTE_UNAVAILABLE`.

Arguments:

- `name` (required): string, at least 1 character

#### `deleteProject`

Deletes a saved project. When it is the open project, the canvas keeps its content.

Not available through a session: it answers `REMOTE_UNAVAILABLE`.

Arguments:

- `projectId` (required): string, at least 1 character

#### `listRecoveryCopies`

Lists recoverable unsaved compositions with id, name, dimensions, layer count, and modification time.

Not available through a session: it answers `REMOTE_UNAVAILABLE`.

Arguments: none. Any field fails with `INVALID_ARGS_UNKNOWN`.

#### `restoreRecoveryCopy`

Restores a recovery copy by id, replacing the current composition. Save current work first if needed.

Not available through a session: it answers `REMOTE_UNAVAILABLE`.

Arguments:

- `id` (required): string, at least 1 character

Other fields fail with `INVALID_ARGS_UNKNOWN`.

#### `discardRecoveryCopy`

Permanently discards a recovery copy by id.

Not available through a session: it answers `REMOTE_UNAVAILABLE`.

Arguments:

- `id` (required): string, at least 1 character

Other fields fail with `INVALID_ARGS_UNKNOWN`.

#### `undo`

Undoes the last change. When `canUndo` is false, nothing changes. Through a session, it does not go back past the composition that the session started with.

Arguments: none.

#### `redo`

Redoes the last undone change. When `canRedo` is false, nothing changes. Through a session, it does not restore a state from before the session.

Arguments: none.

### View and settings

#### `setForegroundColor`

Sets the foreground color from a `#rrggbb` string.

Not available through a session: it answers `REMOTE_UNAVAILABLE`.

Arguments:

- `color` (required): string, matches `/^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/`

#### `setZoom`

Sets the zoom mode.

Arguments:

- `mode` (required): string, one of `fit`, `50`, `100`, `200`

#### `setPan`

Scrolls the canvas viewport to `x`, `y` pixels. The browser clamps the result to the available scroll range.

Arguments:

- `x` (required): integer, 0 or more
- `y` (required): integer, 0 or more

Other fields fail with `INVALID_ARGS_UNKNOWN`.

#### `setTool`

Activates a toolbar tool. Transform requires an active media or drawing layer.

Arguments:

- `tool` (required): string, one of `selection`, `move`, `clone`, `transform`, `brush`, `eraser`, `shape`, `fill`, `eyedropper`, `pan`

Other fields fail with `INVALID_ARGS_UNKNOWN`.

#### `setSelectionTool`

Activates a marquee selection tool and switches to selection mode.

Arguments:

- `tool` (required): string, one of `rectangle`, `oval`, `lasso`, `polygon`, `wand`

Other fields fail with `INVALID_ARGS_UNKNOWN`.

#### `play`

Starts the animation of time-based effects.

Arguments: none.

#### `pause`

Stops the animation. The current frame stays visible.

Arguments: none.

#### `setSettings`

Changes settings. Only `theme` has an effect.

Not available through a session: it answers `REMOTE_UNAVAILABLE`.

Arguments:

- `theme`: string, one of `system`, `gray-dark`, `gray-light`, `neutral-dark`, `neutral-light`, `corporate`, `cyberpunk`, `earthy`, `organic`, `terminal`, `dark`, `light`

### Canvas and adjustments

#### `resizeImage`

Resamples the image and all layers to a new size. The selection does not change. Call `selectNone` to clear it.

Arguments:

- `width` (required): integer, from 1 to 8192
- `height` (required): integer, from 1 to 8192

#### `resizeCanvas`

Changes the canvas size without resampling. `anchor` (default center) sets the position of the layers.

Arguments:

- `width` (required): integer, from 1 to 8192
- `height` (required): integer, from 1 to 8192
- `anchor`: string, one of `top-left`, `top`, `top-right`, `left`, `center`, `right`, `bottom-left`, `bottom`, `bottom-right`

#### `autoLevels`

Adds an adjustment layer that stretches the tonal range. Returns `applied: false` when no change is necessary.

Arguments: none.

#### `autoContrast`

Adds an adjustment layer that stretches luminance to the full range. Returns `applied: false` when no change is necessary.

Arguments: none.

#### `autoWhiteBalance`

Adds an adjustment layer that makes the brightest area neutral white. Returns `applied: false` when no change is necessary.

Arguments: none.

### Fonts

#### `listInstalledFonts`

Returns the state of the font bundle: installed, version, count, and each font as id, family and category.

Not available through a session: it answers `REMOTE_UNAVAILABLE`.

Arguments: none. Any field fails with `INVALID_ARGS_UNKNOWN`.

#### `installFontBundle`

Starts a job that downloads the font bundle (about 140 MB) into browser storage. Returns its `jobId`.

Not available through a session: it answers `REMOTE_UNAVAILABLE`.

Arguments: none. Any field fails with `INVALID_ARGS_UNKNOWN`.

### Online collaboration

#### `takeOnline`

Starts a shared session for the current composition when online collaboration is enabled. Returns the session id; state.collaboration includes the share URL.

Not available through a session: it answers `REMOTE_UNAVAILABLE`.

Arguments: none. Any field fails with `INVALID_ARGS_UNKNOWN`.

#### `joinSession`

Joins a session by id, replacing the current composition without a dialog. Save first if needed.

Not available through a session: it answers `REMOTE_UNAVAILABLE`.

Arguments:

- `sessionId` (required): string, at least 1 character

Other fields fail with `INVALID_ARGS_UNKNOWN`.

#### `goOffline`

Leaves the active shared session without changing the composition.

Not available through a session: it answers `REMOTE_UNAVAILABLE`.

Arguments: none. Any field fails with `INVALID_ARGS_UNKNOWN`.
